  `• NIP      : ${item.NIP}\n` +

SELECT u.id, u.username AS nama, u."NIP" AS nip, u."Jabatan" AS jabatan,
  u.pangkat, u.bidang, u.instansi_id, u."Status" AS status, u.no,
  COALESCE(s.total_masuk, 0) as all_masuk, 
  COALESCE(s.total_pulang, 0) as all_pulang,
  COALESCE(s.total_izin, 0) as all_izin,
  COALESCE(s.total_sakit, 0) as all_sakit,
  COALESCE(s.total_tugas, 0) as all_tugas,
  COALESCE(s.total_tubel, 0) as all_tubel,
  COALESCE(s.total_cuti, 0) as all_cuti,
  COALESCE(s.total_alpa, 0) as all_alpa,
  COALESCE(s.akum_menit_terlambat, 0) as all_menit_terlambat,
  COALESCE(s.akum_menit_lebih_awal, 0) as all_menit_lebih_awal
FROM user_list u
LEFT JOIN statistik_pegawai s ON u.id::text = s.pegawai_id
WHERE u."Status" IS DISTINCT FROM 'NONAKTIF'
  AND u.instansi_id = '{{ $node["Rekap"].json.query.instansi_id || "bapperida" }}'
ORDER BY u.no ASC NULLS LAST
